ROOTDEV.description: The block device path for the root filesystem partition (e.g., /dev/vda2, /dev/sda1). Must be a block device node.

USE_RESIZE2FS.description: Enable resizing for ext2/3/4 filesystems using resize2fs.

USE_XFS_GROWFS.description: Enable resizing for XFS filesystems using xfs_growfs (requires remount on /).
